scheme_name: KARMASHREE- The Chief Minister's Award For Excellence In Public Administration
other_conditions: Group size limited to a maximum of 4 officers including the applicant
Nomination for the Priority Programme award must be from a district or implementing unit
Nomination for the Innovation award must be from a department/organization of the State Government or a district

Selection based on innovativeness, sustainability, scalability, impact on service delivery, improvement in efficiency and effectiveness, social or economic benefits, improved transparency and objectivity, and any other criteria decided by the Screening and Selection Committees
benefits_summary: The award consists of a citation and recognises extraordinary, exemplary and innovative work of State Government officers.
documents_required: Recommendation letter from the competent authority
Legend for abbreviations/acronyms used in the application
Supporting documents (PDFs, JPG images, video clips)
